id.description: Send this as `custom_line_definition_id` on custom line items

line_item_calculation_type.description: Whether the custom line item adds to or takes away from the document's subtotal

credits_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on credits

credits_mode.description: Whether it's added to credits automatically or by hand

invoices_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on invoices

invoices_mode.description: Whether it's added to invoices automatically or by hand

orders_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on orders

orders_mode.description: Whether it's added to orders automatically or by hand

purchases_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on purchases

purchases_mode.description: Whether it's added to purchases automatically or by hand

quotes_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on quotes

quotes_mode.description: Whether it's added to quotes automatically or by hand

shipments_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on shipments

shipments_mode.description: Whether it's added to shipments automatically or by hand

standing_orders_allowed.description: Whether the definition can be used on standing orders

standing_orders_mode.description: Whether it's added to standing orders automatically or by hand

customers_allowed.description: True when the definition is limited to specific customers

vendors_allowed.description: True when the definition is limited to specific vendors

inventories_allowed.description: True when the definition can only be added under lines for specific inventory items
